compile_profile_proposal.licenses: Preserve exact CORE-MATH MIT notice in original source and distributed binary attribution
compile_profile_proposal.loader: Python ctypes loading absolute SHA-identified .dll/.so with signature/abi checks; no fallback to NumPy exp if library load fails
compile_profile_proposal.source_origin: Compile only exact vendored exp.c blob and the separately authored eight-lane wrapper, no mutable package-manager download

zig.name: Zig (bundled zig cc / Clang+LLD)
zig.resolved_runtime_identity_at_qualificati: Record both binary archive sha256, zig version, zig cc -v, generated shared-library hash, compiler options, target CPU/ABI, shared libs, OS image and Python/NumPy wheels; no test completion without these
